This is a direct instance of the TOCTOU check-use race pattern the guideline targets.

Neither candidate shows the SQL injection pattern described in the guideline. Candidate A is an authentication manager using PasswordEncoder and Spring Security — no SQL construction is visible. Candidate B is an OCPP service layer passing parameters to repository methods — no SQL, JDBC, or query builder fragments are visible. The guideline requires concrete evidence of untrusted values concatenated into SQL syntax without parameter binding; both snippets delegate data access to hidden layers, making neither a useful match for a downstream security audit targeting this mechanism.
